name: bua_absa_retrieve
description: Retrieves top matching rows from local ABSA CSV and returns source-specific risk values with citations.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Exact organism name in genus + species format (e.g., 'streptococcus agalactiae').

inputs.name: top_k
inputs.description: How many best matches to return (1-25).

outputs.description: Returns exact matches only. If exact genus+species is not found, returns status=not_found with matches=[] and did_you_mean suggestions.
